question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the sentence.

She was asked by the elders to wear a skirt __covering__ her knees.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"covering"** means to put something over or on top of something else to protect or conceal it. (ढंकना)

 
 
• **Example: **She used a blanket for **covering** herself during the cold night.
 
 
 
• **"Exposing"** refers to making something visible by uncovering it; to reveal something that is usually hidden. (उघाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **The photographer was **exposing** the film to capture the image.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'covering'** is **'exposing'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expecting** (उम्मीद करना): To think or believe something will happen.

 
 
• **Example:** She is **expecting** a parcel in the mail today.
 
 
 
• **Expounding** (व्याख्या करना): To explain or describe something in detail.
 
 
• **Example: **The professor was **expounding** on the principles of physics.
 
 
 
• **Expanding** (विस्तार करना): To increase in size, number, or importance.
 
 
• **Example:** The company is** expanding** its operations overseas.
